layoffs.title: Layoffs: help for workers and employers (U.S. Department of Labor)

what.summary: For workers who have been laid off: direct services, benefits, training opportunities and income support, through state and local agencies and American Job Centers.

evidence.quote: Rapid Response for Laid-Off Workers who have been displaced. Access a comprehensive range of direct services, benefits, training opportunities, and income support.
Many services, from are available through American Job Centers, from resume and interview workshops, career counseling, and job search to re-skilling, skills upgrading, and job training.
